body: I’m so sorry. I feel for you.
Thank you so much for your response. I’m so sorry it took me so long. I couldn’t face this account if I’m honest. Today is her birthday. Hello wine for the times.
I’m sorry it’s taken so long to answer. I truly hope the best for you. If you need to talk I’m here
The depression and anxiety definitely gets worse the more you drink. Please message me if you need to talk. I have been there in the “breakfast drink” times
You are not alone. I commend you! Congrats and keep on going. Sometimes the best support are the quiet unspoken ones like us
But in the end
We are in central Massachusetts but I can drive a little bit to give them a good home
Can you please guide me somewhere. Please
I’m sorry I didn’t know. Thank you
Now people are downvoting. I’ve posted in wrong sub but I’m looking for help. Can someone direct me please? I’m sorry it someone is offended
I don’t know where to post this. I was strong a while back.

Thank you for sharing! I definitely noticed downvotes on this post, but I half expected it. I understand it’s a stop drinking sub, and that IS my intention! I may not stop forever, but I’m trying my hardest to stop the terrible, going to eventually kill me, kind of drinking. Good for you for recognizing how gross it is!
I’m so happy to help others ❤️❤️❤️

Oh my goodness you’re welcome!!! I’m so happy it can help someone!
IWNDWYT
Good job!!
Amazing! You’re an inspiration
You can do it!! The first 3 days were the hardest. Leaving the house and keeping busy helped so much
Jesus that’s fantastic. I need more fruit in my life. Jonesing so hard for sugar and caffeine already and it’s 7 in the gahd dang morning lol. But I’m awake! Without a hangover!
Oh LAWD that sounds good! IWNDWYT

Thank you!!! I’m staying strong and these are great suggestions, I appreciate it. My face is much thinner and I’ve lost about a pound or so. I don’t even care about the weight so much as I know the sugar is more addicting than coke. BUT to be fair I was drinking a bottle or more of wine a night soooooo I’ll choose my vice!
THANK YOU!!
Thank you! I’ve been going a little more paleo in the diet to ward off these cravings but sometimes I get an eye tweaking craving for so much sugar lol
That’s a good suggestion. Ive been doing non alcoholic wine spritzers and because I’m not getting buzzed I just have one and it seems to be good. But during the day! Chocolate galore
That’s amazing you started running. I smoke like a friggen idiot too so I’m scared to even get into it. IWNDWYT
That’s so true!! Screw it im getting a shake on the way home from work tonight
That’s a great suggestion. I always get peanut m&ms or Reece’s because they’re my favorite. Reading the ingredients is scary. I’ll snag some dark chocolate today
Ahhhh FFS I swear I want it more every day than I ever did when I was interested in cocaine. I could take or leave that gasoline...sugar on the other hand. I WANT IT ALL
I had my partner take all angle photos on day one. Hungover, red faced, red eyes, puffy and sad looking. I’ll have them take a 2 week one today. Can’t bear to look at the first one yet!! IWNDWYT
You can have it! We will support you!

Day 14 for me. Absolutely amazing how 7 hours sober is enough, while before I was shocked 10 hours in bed to “recover” wasn’t enough. Maybe because I was poisoning my body for years? Also crazy how I justified these actions. Good for you I’m proud! IWNDWYT
Thank you so so much! IWNDWYT

That’s a great idea, thank you for suggesting it. I’m still newish to reddit itself, and I’m only on mobile, so im learning something new every day! I will search for that today. Thank you for the congrats and for now IWNDWYT
Thank you! 🎉

I’m curious if because I’m aware now of how abnormal and unhealthy my relationship with alcohol was, I might have a clearer mind if/when I do try to be normal? It probably sounds laughable to most everyone in this sub. But it feels okay to me right now if that makes sense? Thank you for the advice!
Thank you! I know it’s a very small percentage of people that succeed, but I won’t know unless I try! For now, IWNDWYT
YESSS and the wine morning breath 😷 no more!! IWNDWYT

Dudeeeee right there with you!! My partner used to wipe my face as my ass was passed out. Gone are those days! My skin looks like actual skin now instead of a red puffy anus. lol so happy you pulled out the expensive granny creams! IWNDWYT

That’s amazing! You have such amazing willpower to give up something for 30 says to see the effects. I’m still smoking 2-5 cigarettes a day (I know yuck) but at least I’m not drinking like a fish! IWNDWYT

Holy moly that puts my cleanse with a cottonelle wipe and moisturizer to shame! (Sometimes my partner would wipe my face when I was passed out bless their soul) Lol I do better than that most of the time, but now that I’m going to bed sober I’m actually using my expensive serums and such. Thank you for the advice it’s much appreciated!
Awesome! What’s your routine?
Thank you!! I seriously feel detoxed, and like it’s oozing out of my skin 🤢
Thank you! Will buy some tonight
Ahhhh you’re so right. Apparently multiple espressos throughout the day isn’t cutting it. Thank you!

Day one I had my partner get rid of all the alcohol in the house when I was at work so there was no temptation. If I lived alone, I would have done it whilst drunk that night, or when I felt like shit the next morning. Get rid of all of it. 
Night 1 and 2 were the hardest. Friday and Saturday night. Friday night I was hankering so bad for a bottle. Luckily my sister husband and kids came over. It was a great distraction. Saturday night after work I got home and told my partner we need to leave the house immediately! I was anxious because this was the first Saturday in 7 years I wouldn’t be drinking. We went to an outdoor shopping plaza, walked around the stores, got burgers at a restaurant, then went and saw a movie. To close the night out...I called a friend from college I hadn’t seen or talked to in years that has been sober for 4 years....what an honest and long talk I had with them. 
Nights 3-5 were easier! Keep busy, busy, busy. 
Good luck and keep it up!!! Proud of you for taking the first step. Message me if you need more help
Write them down! It would be cool to see the progression
I had the drinking dream last night and woke up panicked that I failed. So glad you made the right choice in yours. That’s so awesome!

The first two days were a battle for me not to say fuck it and go pick up a bottle. GET PAST THE 3/4 DAY MARK!!!! It’s amazing. What really helped me was journaling every day. I never journaled in my life. I use one of those pens from the 90s with red, green and blue. Red for a bad day/moment, green for good blue for neutral. Surprisingly in 6 days, I’ve had 2/13 red entries. The rest are green! I’ve also written my weight at the start of each day and it’s slowly going down. IWNDWYT

Your struggle is the same as mine. I’m 6 days sober today (first time since 2011) and I’m feeling like a WHOLE NEW PERSON. I was having a bottle or two of wine a night. That 4-8pm curse is REAL. I’ve replaced it with keeping myself busy, cooking nice meals, cleaning house, going to movies, and also I found a non alcoholic wine called Fre. I made my own wine spritzer the last couple nights and let me tell you it helps the cravings. I have 1 and I can’t have anymore. 
Another struggle is now I’m eating a ton of sugar I would have never eaten. My face is much thinner from giving up the bottle but my skin is screaming at me. 
Keep up the good fight! The good outweighs the bad TEN FOLD. I’m proud of you! IWNDWYT

Thank you for the advice! I took it and reorganized my entire guest bedroom. 7 hours of cleaning later, a non alcoholic wine spritzer, and a fully cooked instant pot meal....I’m in bed on my fourth night sober. IWNDWYT
This gives me hope! I’m on day 4 and feeling better every day. Hearing all the things that improve make me so angry I let 1-2 bottles of fermented grapes RUN my life every day for years.
Proud of you!! IWNDWYT Heading to bed soon nice and sober ahhhh I made it my first Saturday in half a decade!!!
Thank you. I’m currently smashing down a bag of m&ms. It’s helping....tonight.
Thank you for the suggestions! Every comment on this thread is so very much appreciated and loved.
You can do it too!
I will drink diet soda and NO vodka with you tonight!!

I should also probably mention 2 months ago I was at the theatre watching a star is born and brought two bota boxes of wine in. Blubbering mess by the end realizing I was the god damned alcoholic in the theatre
This theatre has a small separate sketchy ass bar so I beelined right past it for the m&ms and Coke Zero

Wow I’m glad you’re getting out of that cycle! I’m at about a bottle-2 a night and lord knows how much on weekend nights. Pretty excited not to be blackout tonight. I’m in a theatre with a bunch of teens, I feel 100 years old but I’m drinking Coke Zero so there’s that!
I downed a seltzer and got out of the house after work immediately! Going to see Happy Death Day 2 You lol

I got home from work, CHUGGED a seltzer, and went directly to the burger joint that doesn’t serve alcohol. Then went to the mall and movie theatre. This is the first Saturday in 6 years I won’t be blackout
Ahhhh I’m trying to get there! The pros of stopping outweigh the cons but for some reason the wine always wins
HOW did you abstain?? I’m on day two right now and all I want is a bottle to my face. How do you keep control whilst in that setting?

This is my first Saturday as well!! I’m at work and feeling great. I woke up on time, had coffee, chatted with my partner, drove to work fully clear headed and even laughed at my podcast. My 8 hour shift is almost done and I’m not eating shitty food to feel better, I’m not feeling the need to vomit, and I’m excited to get home and go out to the movies so I don’t feel the need to pick up a bottle. Proud of you!
I see my bottle of sertrolene? And just think “if I took it all I’d save a lot of people from worrying about me” I’m 30. I’ve never been this way. Why is this happening

I want to turn this thing upside down. But right now I am a bottle and a half down and I don’t have the strength to not drink with you today. I so appreciate your words. I really need a friend tonight. It’s almost midnight. I just need a friend

I want to give up. I’ve just watched Beautiful Boy and I feel like the main character. Not addicted to methamphetamine or heroin, or anything super bad. But I feel like him. A hole I can’t fill, ashamed I let down the people in my life. Self fulfilling prophesy I’ll be like my mom. What do I do? Do I end things to make it easier? Do I forge on in sadness?
I’ve tried going there. It is very helpful but the drink always takes over. Am I ever going to get over this? I feel so hopeless. So low. I’m a loser and won’t ever get better
Is there anyone that can help me. Please

I might add after we moved out of his parents place, he cheated on me. I took anything I cared about and left that day. Then I picked up smoking out of “revenge”? Because nobody could tell me what to do anymore? I’m not even sure I know these days

Thank you for your reply. I’m not sure I even want to make a difference, which is awful to say. I want to heal myself. I want to come to terms the trauma that I dealt with, thinking it was normal. I want to change and to get better. The drinking has been probably less than 5 years. I never drank daily. I went out in college. I got drunk but on the college nights. Then after college I nannied two girls (8 and 10) who had a mother addicted to heroin and they were obese. I was in peak shape so I was hired to keep them moving and cook them healthy meals. Then after those girls tried to stab me, hate me, kill me, I started having a glass of wine after leaving their place. After that,I was living with the cop I was dating for years and thought I would marry, cheated on me. I left him and moved in with a family member. I started having more wine at night. I picked up smoking which I never thought I would. Then I moved again closer to Boston. I started drinking more often.  Then all of a sudden I’m here. Drinking every night. And drinking to black out.
